automationNotes: Doc: [Edit an Experience](https://www.contentstack.com/docs/personalize/edit-experience) — **Editing an Experience Draft** path. **Prereq:** at least one **Draft** experience in the project. **Row ⋮:** `button[data-test-id="cs-table-action-options"]` scoped by **`PERSONALIZE_EDIT_EXPERIENCE_ROW_CONTAINS`** (else substring **AUTO**). After open menu, wait **`VERTICAL_ELLIPSIS_POST_OPEN_MS`** (default **2000** ms), then **`[data-test-id="cs-vertical-action-tooltip-actions"] li[data-test-id="cs-ct-action-edit"]`** — hover, verify doc **Edit** (UI may show **Edit Text**). **Project card:** `PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_CARD_CONTAINS` / `DAL_PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_SEARCH`. DOM: `data/dom/Personalize/experiences.html`.
